## Your Office Space: property representation connected to your business

Your Office Space represents commercial tenants and buyers in Newcastle, the Hunter and NSW. We start with what your business needs the property to do, then organise the search, evidence, commercial negotiation and agreed coordination workstream around that brief.

For a tenant, that means looking beyond the asking rent to the lease term, outgoings, incentives, make-good requirements and the cost of moving. For a buyer, it means bringing the intended use, property requirements, due diligence questions and appointed professional advisers into a clear decision process.

Our practical difference is the connection between the property decision and the workplace that follows. YOS can coordinate separately agreed client-side FitOut project management, furniture and workplace services. You can engage us for representation alone; each additional service has its own agreed scope and fees.

[Explore YOS tenant representation](/tenant-rep), [discuss commercial buying](/buyers-agency) or [start a free Lease Health Check](/lease-health-check).

## How this comparison is organised

This article is published by Your Office Space, a provider of tenant representation and commercial buyers agency services. YOS appears first; the other providers are listed alphabetically. The selected comparison uses published commercial services and a Newcastle connection, checked on 16 November 2026. It is a starting point for interviews, rather than an exhaustive directory or an independent ranking.

A Newcastle office, a Newcastle case study and a general NSW service area are different forms of local evidence. We distinguish them below. A service mentioned on a website does not confirm current availability, fees or suitability for your assignment.

## What makes YOS different for a Newcastle business owner?

### A brief built around operations

We ask what the premises must support: staff and visitors, clinical or office use, access, parking, layout, timing and the business’s likely next stage. The purpose is to assess opportunities against your requirements rather than let the first attractive listing set the strategy.

### One view of the workplace commitment

Rent or purchase price is one part of the decision. FitOut, furniture, technology, relocation and ongoing operating requirements can affect whether a space works for your business. We help organise those questions and the relevant specialist inputs before you commit.

Use the [lease cost comparison](/resources/lease-comparison) and [FitOut estimator](/resources/fitout-estimator) as planning aids, then confirm the actual scope, professional advice and property-specific costs. Calculator outputs are indicative and do not establish the cost of a transaction or project.

### Representation with clear professional boundaries

Your solicitor, accountant, finance broker, valuer and building specialists advise within their appointed disciplines. You choose and appoint those advisers. YOS coordinates the agreed commercial property workstream and keeps the outstanding questions visible; we do not provide legal, tax, financial, credit or investment advice.

For subsequent works, YOS provides client-side project management. Appropriately appointed contractors perform construction; YOS is not the builder or head contractor.

## Recovery Station: a real tenant representation example

Recovery Station had spent six months looking for new clinical and office space around Maitland before engaging YOS in March 2026. Suitable opportunities were being taken quickly, and the business had repeatedly missed out.

After considering five potential properties, YOS identified a larger tenancy that was initially unsuitable. When it could be split, Recovery Station received the first opportunity to consider the smaller tenancy before it went to market. The approximately 100 m² space at Suite B, 66 King Street, East Maitland offered reception, two existing clinical rooms, accessible entry from the car park and shared amenities within an established medical centre.

YOS negotiated a successful rent-free period and agreed landlord works, while maintaining communication with the agent to keep negotiations moving. The lease was signed in August 2026. Recovery Station completed the final lease review and controlled the decision to proceed.

Beth Gwalter, Founding Director, Recovery Station, said: “For us, it meant we could stay focused on our core business while knowing the property side was being properly managed.”

[Read the approved Recovery Station case study](/case-studies/recovery-station-east-maitland-tenant-representation). This is a documented client example, not a promise that another business will secure the same property, incentive or timing.

## Compare the representation scope

Your Office Space provides tenant representation in NSW and commercial buyers agency, particularly for businesses moving from leasing to buying. Start with your business objective, the premises requirements and the decision you need help making.

Ask each adviser who they act for, what the appointment covers, how fees and conflicts are disclosed, and which legal, finance and technical specialists you must appoint separately. Confirm the scope in writing before engaging a representative.

## Tenant representative, buyers agent or listing agent?

The title on a business card is less useful than the actual appointment. Before sharing confidential negotiating instructions, establish who the adviser represents on your transaction.

| Your requirement | Service to clarify | Questions to resolve |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lease, renew or relocate business premises | Commercial tenant representation | Who acts for the tenant, how options are compared and what negotiation support is included |
| Buy a commercial property | Commercial buyers agency or acquisition representation | Search scope, intended use, due diligence coordination, negotiation and professional adviser responsibilities |
| Establish a property value or rental opinion | An appropriately scoped valuation or consultancy assignment | Purpose, methodology, written report and any reliance limitations |
| Enquire about a property being marketed | The listing agency’s role | Who appointed the agent and whose interests the agent represents in the transaction |

A firm may offer more than one service. Ask about its role, remuneration and any actual or potential conflicts for your specific instruction. Have your solicitor explain the proposed agency agreement before signing.

## Seven questions to ask before choosing your representative

1. **Who will you represent?** Obtain a clear explanation of the client relationship, remuneration and relevant conflicts.
2. **What property types and areas suit your current scope?** Ask about your particular office, clinic, retail or industrial brief, not just a broad service label.
3. **Who will do the work?** Confirm inspections, local attendance, communication and decision-making responsibilities.
4. **What is included in the fee?** Ask about search, assessment, negotiation, due diligence coordination and any exclusions or additional appointments.
5. **How will we compare opportunities?** Request a consistent brief and evidence framework covering the whole occupancy or acquisition decision.
6. **Where do professional advisers fit?** Identify who provides legal, valuation, planning, building, tax and finance advice, and when those inputs are required.
7. **What happens after the property decision?** Clarify whether relocation or workplace coordination is included, separately available or outside the appointment.

Check the relevant licence and the proposed written agreement using [Service NSW’s property agent licence check guidance](https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/check-a-property-agent-licence-or-certificate). This guide does not certify the licensing or suitability of any provider.

## Questions business owners ask

### Who is the best tenant representative in Newcastle?

The best fit depends on your premises, transaction and required support. YOS is a starting point for businesses wanting tenant-side representation connected to the whole workplace brief. Interview providers against the same scope and ask for relevant, verifiable experience rather than relying on a ranking label.

### Can YOS help with both leasing and buying?

Yes. YOS offers tenant representation and commercial buyers agency services in NSW. The search brief, engagement scope, fees and specialist advisers are confirmed for the actual instruction.

### Does the landlord’s agent represent our business?

Confirm the agent’s actual appointment and role. An agent engaged to market a landlord’s premises should not be assumed to be your tenant representative. Ask who is represented and obtain your own professional advice before committing.

### Do we have to buy FitOut or furniture services with representation?

No. You can engage YOS for representation alone. Any FitOut project management, furniture or other workplace service is separately agreed, with its own scope and fees.

## Start with your business objective

Tell us whether you are leasing, renewing, relocating or buying, along with the preferred area, timing and what the premises need to do. You can start with your name and email; the team can help clarify the brief.

[Start a free Lease Health Check](/lease-health-check), [send a commercial buying enquiry](/buyers-agency#buyer-enquiry) or [use the enquiry form below](#blog-contact-form).

If furnishing the premises is part of the decision, see our [Newcastle office furniture companies comparison](/blog/best-office-furniture-companies-newcastle) and bring the requirements into the property brief early.

General information only. Obtain transaction-specific advice from appropriately qualified professional advisers before entering a lease, purchase or agency agreement. Outcomes, availability, scope and fees require confirmation.
